plugin.name: Luogu
plugin.description: Query Luogu problems/search/contests/user profiles, with login-based submission analysis and daily problem set push.
panel.title: Luogu
panel.heatmap.title: Practice heatmap
actions.refresh_heatmap.label: Refresh heatmap
actions.save.label: Save credentials
actions.clear.label: Clear credentials
entry.search.name: Search Luogu problems
entry.detail.name: Get problem detail
entry.detail.description: Get statement, difficulty, tags, accept/submit counts and solution links.
entry.hint.name: Get a problem hint
entry.hint.description: Distil one non-spoiling approach hint from a Luogu editorial — a pointer, no code, so you still do the thinking.
entry.contest.name: Get contest list
entry.profile.name: Get user profile
entry.profile.description: Get public user profile; includes private stats when logged in.
entry.submissions.name: Get submissions
entry.submissions.description: Get the logged-in user's submissions (AC/WA, difficulty, tags).
entry.growth.name: Growth report
entry.growth.description: Analyze weak/untouched tags from submissions and give growth advice.
entry.ability.name: Estimate ability level
entry.ability.description: Estimate the comfortable difficulty (Luogu 1-8) from weighted solve evidence — difficulty, attempts and recency — optionally recalibrating from the stored level.
entry.daily.name: Daily problem set
entry.daily.description: Generate today's recommended problems from the growth strategy.
entry.push_daily.name: Push daily problem set
entry.push_daily.description: Generate a problem set and push to configured group/private or dialog.
entry.set_push_target.name: Configure push target
entry.set_push_target.description: Configure the group/QQ for daily problem set push.
entry.list_push_targets.name: List push targets
entry.review_due.name: Review queue due today
entry.review_due.description: List problems due for review; the ladder is 1/2/4/7/15/30/60 days.
entry.review_add.name: Add to review queue
entry.review_add.description: Queue a problem for its first review in one day; title/difficulty/tags fall back to the plugin's cached metadata.
entry.review_feedback.name: Record review result
entry.review_feedback.description: Record how a review went and schedule the next one: forgot resets, shaky repeats, ok advances, easy skips a step.
entry.refresh_heatmap.name: Refresh practice heatmap
entry.refresh_heatmap.description: Fetch submissions and recompute the practice heatmap (distinct problems accepted per day), caching the result for the Hosted UI.
entry.save.name: Save Luogu credentials
entry.save.description: Encrypt allow-listed Luogu login cookies into the plugin private directory.
entry.clear.name: Clear Luogu credentials
entry.clear.description: Delete saved Luogu login cookies from the plugin private directory.
errors.invalid_cookie: Invalid cookie format (a login uid field is required).
